name: China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited
summary: China Railway Construction Heavy Industry Corporation Limited engages in the research, design, development, manufacturing, leasing, sale, and servicing of tunnel boring machines, rail transit equipment, and specialized equipment in China and internationally. The company offers tunnel boring machines, drilling and blasting construction equipment, rail track and transit systems, agricultural machines, green building materials construction equipment, new construction materials, and mine construction equipment.
